name: Liechtenstein

flag.description: Two equal horizontal bands, blue over red, with a gold crown in the upper hoist corner.
flag.symbolism: Blue is said to represent the sky and red the glow of evening fires in homes; the crown stands for the unity of the people and the princely house.

hook: Blue over red with a gold crown: Liechtenstein added the crown after discovering its plain flag matched Haiti's, so crown means Liechtenstein, central crest means Haiti.
trivia: At the 1936 Berlin Olympics Liechtenstein discovered its flag was identical to Haiti's civil flag, and added the crown in 1937.
Liechtenstein is one of only two doubly landlocked countries, along with Uzbekistan.
